name: Las Vegas Strip Circuit
summary: A Saturday-night race down the Las Vegas Strip, past the casinos and the Sphere.
character: Long straights, including almost 2 km on the Strip itself, and cold night air that makes it hard to get heat into the tyres. Low grip and high top speeds mean lots of overtaking.

corners.name: The Strip
corners.note: A flat-out run past the casinos at over 340 km/h.

corners.name: Sphere section
corners.note: A string of corners that wraps around the Sphere arena.

moments.title: The drain cover
moments.body: A loose water valve cover wrecked Carlos Sainz's Ferrari minutes into the first practice session. Second practice ran from 2:30 to 4 a.m. after fans had been sent home. The race turned out to be good.

history.body: Las Vegas first hosted F1 on a track laid out in the Caesars Palace car park.
First race on the Strip circuit.
